body.message:
Good afternoon,

We would like to inform you that we have received a request from the owner to arrange a brief viewing of the unit for bank valuation purposes, which is required as part of the necessary renewal process for the property.

We kindly request your cooperation in allowing access for the valuation team. The visit will be brief and will be arranged at a time that is convenient for you, with minimal disruption to your stay.

Could you please let us know your preferred date and time within the next two days? We will coordinate with the concerned team and share the confirmed schedule with them accordingly.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
